summary: Trait: one chosen per-life Verbal (4th level or lower) also gains Charge x5, or one per-refresh Verbal gains Charge x10.

effects.subject: bearer

params.scope: a single purchased per-life Verbal of 4th level or lower

effects.note: In addition to the Verbal's normal frequency.

effects.subject: bearer

params.scope: a single purchased per-refresh Verbal of 4th level or lower

effects.note: In addition to the Verbal's normal frequency.

requirements.note: The Verbal is determined before the game begins and cannot be changed.

restrictions.note: Either the per-life option (Charge x5) OR the per-refresh option (Charge x10), for a single Verbal.
The Verbal must be one the player purchased.

properties.note: Choose one per-life Verbal (Charge x5) or one per-refresh Verbal (Charge x10) before the game.

open_questions: Max 2 per class: whether a second instance may pick the other option or another Verbal is not stated; each instance is read as its own single Verbal.
